title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
Good morning, Matthew ☕ — Thursday, September 10, 2026

🌤️ Weather
Mostly cloudy early, then turning sunny. High near 85°F, low tonight around 72°F. Just a 20% chance of an early shower. Warm and pleasant — light layers, sunglasses for the afternoon, no umbrella needed.

🗞️ Headlines
• Brent crude closed above $100/barrel for the first time since May, driven by Middle East tensions.
• The U.S.–Iran conflict enters its seventh month with no resolution in sight.
• Israel faces mounting international pressure over settlement expansion.
• Trump headlined the RNC Midterm Convention as the fall campaign ramps up.
• TSA is reintroducing limited airport gate access for non-ticketed visitors at select airports.

🚇 Getting around
Nothing major system-wide today. Heads up for this weekend: starting tomorrow (9/11), G trains won't run between Court Sq and Bedford–Nostrand Avs — free shuttle buses will fill the gap.

🎉 NYC today
• NY Philharmonic gala at Radio City with Gustavo Dudamel, Lizzo, St. Vincent & Aaron Tveit, 7:30 PM.
• Robyn plays Barclays Center, 8 PM.
Also, ahead of tomorrow's 9/11 anniversary, FDNY firehouses citywide open to the public 10 AM–2 PM for remembrance visits.

💡 Nugget
Brent crude passing $100 tends to ripple into gas prices within a couple of weeks — if you're driving anywhere this month, filling up sooner rather than later isn't a bad call.
